title: Pixel Rush
description: Tap the lowest pixel, then keep the board moving. A four-lane reflex game with timed, endless, and practice modes.

controls.keyboard: D / F / J / K for lanes 1-4. Repeated key holds do not score.
controls.mouse: Click the lowest live target, above the bottom row. Each hit scrolls the board.
controls.touch: Tap those pixels to bash them all!

thumbnailAlt: Four lanes of colorful pixel creatures, with a live target above the last tapped dimmed character
